description: This Scala source file defines the SparkConnectInterceptorRegistry object, which manages a registry of gRPC interceptors for Spark's SQL connect service. It includes methods for creating, chaining, and configuring interceptors based on Spark configuration, and handles instantiation with error handling.

classes.name: SparkConnectInterceptorRegistry
classes.description: Object managing the registration and creation of gRPC interceptors for Spark SQL connect service.

methods.name: chainInterceptors
methods.description: Chains all configured interceptors to a NettyServerBuilder instance.

methods.name: createConfiguredInterceptors
methods.description: Creates a sequence of configured ServerInterceptor instances based on Spark configuration.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Instantiates a ServerInterceptor subclass using its default constructor with error handling.

methods.name: interceptor
methods.description: Creates a callable that instantiates a specific ServerInterceptor class.
